rationale: A prospectively pre-registered, independently human-approved research seed is a coherent experimental governance path, not empirical truth. No actual seed, unit, counting rule, terminal rule or bootstrap authority is approved. Origin/parcel and exact forward calendar/price closure also remain necessary. Decision B describes design readiness, not executable cohort readiness; Decision C would overstate current source closure.

frozen_findings.statement: These are retained predecessor findings at the stated audit cutoff, not a new live database census.

definition.purpose: A provisional, independently justified, documented convention used only to prebind a prospective paired-research endpoint so future observations can mature.
definition.scientific_limit: Preregistration can reduce outcome-dependent flexibility and make design bias auditable; it cannot justify an arbitrary seed, guarantee neutral data, establish predictive accuracy or remove missing-source requirements.

mechanism_routes.name: EXISTING_GOVERNED_STRATEGY_DURATION
mechanism_routes.evidence: Pinned horizon audits and approved Pre-Breakout provenance contain no semantically compatible numeric paired duration.
mechanism_routes.prerequisites: An exact same-purpose independent policy with evidence, applicability, native validity and D-visible approval would be required.
mechanism_routes.limitation: Descriptive strategy intent, holding statistics, paper expiry, bar timeframe, blackout and business milestone windows cannot be promoted.

mechanism_routes.name: EXTERNALLY_GOVERNED_RESEARCH_PRIOR
mechanism_routes.evidence: COS methodology is not a financial duration prior. No independently authoritative HSI-compatible numeric external prior was established.
mechanism_routes.prerequisites: Original source/version, publication/access chronology, method, population, limitations, category/strategy applicability, data rights and conflict disclosures; explicit HSI human adoption.
mechanism_routes.limitation: External authors, an RA signature or analyst preference do not self-register a parameter or make it calibrated.

mechanism_routes.name: PREREGISTERED_PROSPECTIVE_SEED_POLICY
mechanism_routes.evidence: Existing immutable human-policy lineage and source/PIT protocols can support a separate prospective research design; preregistration methodology supports transparent pre-specification.
mechanism_routes.prerequisites: Evidence-based rationale independent of measured future returns; complete parameter/convention package; explicit human approval, registration before D, genuine origins/parcel and source closure.
mechanism_routes.limitation: No unsupported number may be approved by AI. No collection is ready merely because governance is definable.

mechanism_routes.name: MULTIPLE_PROSPECTIVE_RESEARCH_HORIZONS
mechanism_routes.evidence: Predecessor requires exactly one canonical horizon per original pair and counts exact duplicate origins once.
mechanism_routes.prerequisites: Would require a separately authorized predecessor-changing protocol outside this slice.
mechanism_routes.limitation: New wrapper IDs, separate cohort names or preregistration do not legitimize multi-horizon fan-out for the same original pair.

mechanism_routes.name: NO_BOOTSTRAP_PERMITTED
mechanism_routes.evidence: No registered complete seed package or eligible origins exist in the retained evidence.
mechanism_routes.prerequisites: Remain closed until all required approvals and source conditions are met.
mechanism_routes.limitation: Design-level conditional feasibility does not remove the actual current block.

research_authority.enforcement_proposal: Future bootstrap approval and reader must use distinct research-only identity/scope and positive admission checks. Never reuse production source IDs/approval enums to masquerade as production. Existing live allowlists/readers remain unchanged; no downgrade/fallback acceptance.

selection_independence.safety_stop: Source/integrity/legal problems may stop future admission through an explicit new governance event; retain existing versions, original denominator and exclusions. Do not hide early losses or relabel endpoints.

states.meaning: Draft mechanism/parameter package; no policy approval or admission.
Future explicit human approval of a complete evidenced package; approval alone is not registration or source readiness.
Future separately enabled collector admits only genuine fully source-closed D-bound observations after valid pre-registration.
Frozen cohort reviewed under separately approved split/method rules. No implied new admission or seed changes.
A new independently approved prospective version replaces future use; old observations keep original bindings.
Unjustified/invalid policy is not used for new admission; original records and reasons retained.

transitions.condition: Complete evidenced parameter package and explicit attested human approval; not an automated test/hash result.
Separate registration plus source/parcel/calendar/price and collector authorization; registration < each eligible D.
Separate predeclared sampling/split/calibration protocol; no automatic numerical adequacy rule.
Replacement policy independently approved for future eligible D; historical version unchanged.
Documented withdrawal or source/integrity failure; do not erase former approvals.
Documented source/integrity/legal stop; retain denominator and unresolved outcomes, never performance cherry-picking.
Governed evidence review rejects adequacy or applicability; keep history.

lifecycle.retained_seed_after_review: If supported for future reuse, require a new explicit review/selection event under separately approved lifecycle policy; no silent UNDER_CALIBRATION_REVIEW -> accumulation or production transition.

evidence_classes.provenance_required: Exact approved version, owner, evidence links and temporal scope; distinguish intent from holding duration.
evidence_classes.limitations: Does not supply a number where policy has none.

evidence_classes.permitted_role: Explain why a proposed measurement period answers a stated research question.
evidence_classes.provenance_required: Original dated design document, authorship, applicability, limitations and prior-data-access disclosure.
evidence_classes.limitations: Cannot be analyst preference disguised as empirical calibration.

evidence_classes.provenance_required: Primary identifiable study/version/method/population and data rights; applicability assessment and conflicts.
evidence_classes.limitations: Generic preregistration literature supplies no financial horizon.

evidence_classes.permitted_role: Accountable review of a documented research prior.
evidence_classes.provenance_required: Exact reviewed manifest, verified role/delegation and any relied-on registration claim, rationale, conflicts and immutable attestation.
evidence_classes.limitations: RA title/signature does not confer calibration, HSI registration or execution power.

evidence_classes.permitted_role: Possible independent comparator for a seed proposal.
evidence_classes.provenance_required: Original source, actual duration purpose, historic method and population, not a copied marketing description.
evidence_classes.limitations: Different instruments/returns/exit rules may be incompatible; no direct transfer.

evidence_classes.permitted_role: Identify coverage constraints, bias and design questions.
evidence_classes.provenance_required: Predeclared non-authoritative exploration; sources, cutoffs, all analyses and prior outcome access disclosed.
evidence_classes.limitations: No best-return horizon search or conversion to PIT-governed prospective cohort.

evidence_classes.permitted_role: Define transparent prior, measurement objective, endpoint and future validation separation.
evidence_classes.provenance_required: Independent rationale plus exact complete package preregistered before D with explicit human approval.
evidence_classes.limitations: Pre-registration alone cannot justify an unsupported number or prove unbiased/optimal results.

human_AI_RA.human_option: Internal HSI research-governance owner or explicitly delegated attested human may approve a documented research-only package under a future scoped policy. No such approval is recorded here.
human_AI_RA.attestation: A human: prefix is a repository identifier convention, not proof of authentication, delegation, RA registration or informed parameter approval. Verify actual approval provenance; never fabricate it.
human_AI_RA.RA_option: An RA may provide independently documented review and, if explicitly designated under HSI governance, act as a research-only approver. Verify registration/professional claim when relied on; RA title alone is not HSI authority.
human_AI_RA.legal_limit: No blanket legal exemption is concluded. Applicability to client-facing research services, publication or regulated activity needs separate compliance review; this internal design neither offers recommendations nor grants a licence.

fields.validation: Exact research-only policy identity distinct from production authority.
Immutable policy version; no mutation or alias to later versions.
RESEARCH_BOOTSTRAP_ONLY and explicit non-production restrictions.
Exact source-backed categories/strategy versions and supported venue/instrument states; no defaults.
Only independently justified and separately human-approved value; missing blocks registration.
Separately approved exact unit, not implicit sessions/days.
Start exactly D; explicit first/partial/special-session handling and calendar-count method.
Frozen endpoint and completion phase under explicit exception policy; no nearest bar/date roll.
Canonical start/terminal observation, economic/adjustment basis and precision; unknowns stay blocked.
Canonical calendar ID/version/fingerprint, D-visible sources and bounded applicability coverage.
Exact rationale and primary/design source references, prior-data-access disclosures and limitations.
Canonical manifest fingerprint excluding only its own digest; no downstream approval/registration fingerprints as circular inputs.
Attested designated human, authority/delegation, explicit research-only decision, conflicts and approved policy fingerprint.
UTC-aware true approval time, not retroactively inferred from a file date.
Canonical immutable approval content referencing the policy fingerprint, not vice versa.
True UTC pre-registration time strictly before each eligible D; no backdating.
Explicit version-validity boundary, not earlier than registration; must be effective at D.
Exact policy validity/withdrawal/supersession rule; no borrowed universal effective-to semantics.
Immutable record binding exact policy/approval fingerprints and registration/effectivity/scope.
Separate append-only event with true timestamp, reason and referenced policy; never mutate approved manifest or former cohort.
Reuse frozen paired wire/identity; identical complete horizon on both legs and original D source closure.

registration.chronological_note: Strict pre-registration before D is a proposed bootstrap-specific safeguard required by prospective-first design, not a change to native existing policy inclusive/exclusive rules. No invented epsilon or same-timestamp causal order; unresolved ordering fails closed.
registration.privacy: Preregistration means immutable HSI-governed evidence receipt; it does not require uploading private portfolio/source data to OSF or another public service.
registration.source_integrity: Verify native policy/approval/source fingerprints first; then canonical UTC serialization, stable ordered references and complete wrapper fingerprint. No repair-by-rehash.
registration.lifecycle_fingerprint_rule: Events reference prior immutable policy/approval/registration objects; policy fingerprint never includes downstream objects or mutable current status. Verify native sources before any UTC wrapper; duplicate conflicting references fail closed.

historical_application.exploration_may_inform: Data feasibility, descriptive domain context, bias and methodological questions for a future proposal, with all prior data access disclosed.

cohort.parcel_missing: Raw origin archive may be retained under separately authorized source governance; not an admissible paired observation. Missing original parcel/policy proof cannot be supplied by a later choice.
cohort.original_missing: Do not fabricate rotation events from Watch, OHLCV, AI/user hypothetical pairs or current holdings.
cohort.duplicate_policy: One original logical pair counts once; retain alias receipts, no multi-horizon fan-out.
cohort.maturity: Retain predecessor: invalid horizon/calendar => UNRESOLVED; R before end => PENDING_MATURITY; MATURE requires R >= frozen end and exact completed-phase proof known by R. MATURE alone is not complete label/admission.
cohort.label: Both legs, prices, corporate actions, funding/quantity/residual and versioned realized-wealth method must independently pass; otherwise no complete label.

transition_to_calibration.OOS: Predeclare chronology, dependence, overlap/purge/embargo and untouched evaluation. Seed data informing a new policy are not that policy's untouched test data.
transition_to_calibration.source_effectivity: Later approval cannot turn historical D into authorized D. New category/strategy versions apply only prospectively after independent approval.

bias_controls.mechanism: Events resolving outside the seed end are unobserved or differently measured.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Report endpoints, source coverage and the inability to infer unmeasured paths; do not extrapolate returns.

bias_controls.mechanism: The seed defines the estimand and sample maturity; resulting data are not horizon-neutral.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Report seed version and conditioning; a new duration needs its own prospective governance and validation.

bias_controls.mechanism: Unresolved prices, suspension/delistings, late evidence and immature pairs selectively disappear if filtered.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Retain original denominator and all inherited exclusion/maturity states; predeclare treatment without zero/last-price filling.

bias_controls.mechanism: One category may combine distinct strategies or both categorical horizons.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Pin exact strategy/category scope; report subgroup coverage; any later split applies prospectively, not outcome-based per pair.

bias_controls.mechanism: Early observations may represent one market environment.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Report D-known regime/subperiod/sector coverage and uncertainty; no stationarity claim or invented adequacy threshold.

bias_controls.mechanism: Current membership or complete-price/winner-only analysis omits failed origins.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Archive original identity/universe/parcel context and missing outcomes; no synthetic backfill or dropping inconvenient origins.

bias_controls.mechanism: Official endpoints alone cannot evaluate resolution beyond that duration.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: State limitation; separately governed raw-path retention may inform later research but never supplies a replacement official horizon.

bias_controls.mechanism: Changing the seed after early underperformance contaminates later evaluation and erases failure evidence.
bias_controls.later_calibration_must_report: Preserve every version and prior data access; independently approved prospective successor and untouched validation required, never same-cohort relabeling.

raw_paths.data_layer: Only separately authorized existing provider-versioned source storage may retain exact event/received/adjustment/identity/corporate-action lineage, coverage gaps and acquisition versions. No new store or collector in this slice.
raw_paths.use: Later exploratory/calibration use requires explicit predeclared access/split/method governance. Record that paths were seen; no return-ranked seed, contaminated OOS or implicit fan-out.
raw_paths.period: Outside-seed retention length/coverage and cadence require separate source/licence/resource approval. No indefinite path collection implied.
raw_paths.symmetry: Availability of one leg's longer path does not create a second horizon or complete paired label.

dependencies.requirement: Jointly justify seed, scope and category/strategy treatment; no categorical midpoint or existing convenient window.
Approve unit and pre-open/intraday/after-close/partial/special-session conventions together; D stays fixed.
Approve exact end/price/completion/exception conventions together; absence blocks admission.
Use canonical explicit-as-of calendar/phase and native source-verification contracts; future actual range must be covered.
Use historical identity/lifecycle and provider-versioned temporal/adjustment evidence; closure is not supplied by governance.
A separately authorized original-event archival path must preserve genuine D-bound pair/parcel. No portfolio action or source synthesis.
No resolver, producer, schema, migration or collector here; future versioned research wrapper must not mutate frozen wire contracts.
Define adequacy, censoring, dependence, train/validation/OOS and review thresholds independently; none supplied here.
If pursued, govern scope, length, access and resources without extra official horizons.

calendar.assessment: Bounded prospective source facts exist, not blanket forward readiness. No effective bootstrap date or horizon is selected, so actual admission range cannot yet be certified.
conditions: every required counting date and terminal phase covered
NSE cash-equity venue and security-specific continuity/tradability
exact terminal completion and price known by R
calendar.probe_scope: Pure existing calendar queries at explicit fixed cutoffs; no synthetic paired events, source acquisition, fresh DB census or market-hours execution.
calendar.unexpected_closure: Later closure cannot roll the frozen endpoint. Retain unresolved/excluded state under inherited protocol.

prospective_first.governance: One new prospective cohort only after independent complete package approval/registration and source gates; do not reconstruct an authoritative old cohort.
prospective_first.rationale: Breaks self-justifying outcome loop by a transparently justified prior selected before the outcomes it measures. It does not prove the prior optimal or create missing source events.
prospective_first.time_to_evidence: No numerical schedule is supportable before seed/count/end approval; at least actual frozen endpoint completion and source availability are required, then enough governed data for calibration and untouched prospective validation.

readiness.basis: Frozen circularity and missing canonical pairs establish necessity; not permission to collect.
No independently authoritative numeric prior in the pinned chain.
Approved Pre-Breakout governance is not paired duration authority.
Methodology sources support preregistration boundaries, not an HSI seed value.
Existing explicit human governance pattern; new scoped approval and evidence still required. RA-specific prerequisite not established here.
Immutable policy/approval/selection patterns exist; no bootstrap schema, reader or authority is registered.
Documented RESEARCH_BOOTSTRAP_ONLY; never live Gate-1 authority.
BOOTSTRAP_PARAMETER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; value/range/grid remain empty.
Effective unit not approved; no borrowing calendar-day or session defaults.
D counts, partial/special sessions and precision require same approval package.
Exact endpoint/price/completion convention and exceptions not approved.
Conditional forward ordinary/holiday/special evidence; actual D/end range and missing phases must close before admission.
Earlier ordinary sessions incomplete; no backcast or historical grandfathering.
Genuine original decision and exact archived pair remain prerequisites; previous inspected stores contained zero.
Exact original D-bound parcel/capital provenance absent; whole holding is not a default.
Non-authoritative paths compatible in principle; separate collection, licensing, retention and calibration governance required.
Existing UNRESOLVED/PENDING_MATURITY/MATURE boundary; maturity alone does not confer a complete label or admission.
Stage separation and immutable version/cohort boundary defined; no calibrated policy available.
Existing split/replay machinery but zero paired OOS/stability proof; adequacy/split policy remains unset.
V1 ACTIVE; V2 NOT_ACTIVE. Bootstrap is ineligible for production horizon/scenario authority.

external_sources.title: Center for Open Science — Preregistration
external_sources.permitted_claim: Pre-specification distinguishes planned and exploratory analysis; outcome reuse and undisclosed changes weaken inference.
external_sources.does_not_support: No investment duration, HSI authority, empirical strategy validation or universal calendar rule.
external_sources.fingerprint_note: Remote bytes not retained or hashed; exact source and inspected sections recorded. Artifact checksum covers this source annotation, not the remote page.

external_sources.title: SEBI Master Circular for Research Analysts, February 06, 2026
inspected_sections: 1.7 Use of Artificial Intelligence in RA services
external_sources.permitted_claim: RA/entity responsibility for AI-assisted client services and supporting research records is distinct from an internal HSI approval identifier.
external_sources.does_not_support: No HSI bootstrap duration, seed endorsement, trading permission or blanket internal-research legal exemption.
external_sources.fingerprint_note: Remote bytes not retained or hashed; cite identified circular and sections, not claimed immutable local regulatory snapshot.

sources_scope: Targeted primary methodology/regulatory context plus pinned repository audit. Literature supports design transparency only; HSI-specific safeguards below derive from user scope and frozen protocols. No outside numerical prior found or selected.
blockers_closed: Defined seed as research convention rather than calibrated authority
Evaluated all five routes and rejected multi-horizon workaround
Specified immutable approval/preregistration and cohort version boundary
Separated bounded forward calendar feasibility from invalid historical bootstrap
Specified prospective-only fallback and unresolved parameter/source gates
next_scope: One governance-only parameter/convention proposal: obtain or document independent category/strategy rationale for a human-reviewed seed package; specify unit, D/session counting, endpoint, price, precision, applicability and bounded forward-source coverage together. Leave unsupported values unset and return explicit approval questions if no defensible value exists. No AI-selected arbitrary seed, registration, collection, labels, calibration or activation.
